title: Never Cease to Praise
lyrics_original: And our hearts will be so

bible_verses.english: Therefore let's also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let's run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might. Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

Not only so, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope: and hope doesn't disappoint us, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, help me keep my eyes set firmly on You as I run the race before me. When trials weigh heavy and my spirit grows tired, grant me Your strength to endure and the grace to rejoice. Arm my mind with Your truth and guard my heart against discouragement. May my life be a continual song of trust, honoring You through every season. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life's journey often brings wearying battles and unexpected hardships, yet we are never called to run alone. As we fix our eyes on Jesus, His enduring grace transforms our struggles into stepping stones of faith. In every trial, He invites us to adopt His mind, renewing our strength so we never lose heart. Today, take courage knowing that the One who began this good work in you will faithfully carry you to the finish line.
